question: What term is used to denote intermixing of particles of two different types of matter on their own?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Diffusion**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term for the intermixing of particles of two different types of matter on their own is diffusion
 
• Diffusion is a process that occurs when molecules intermingle due to their kinetic energy and random continuous motion.
 
• It happens when particles move from a region of higher concentration to a region of lower concentration
 
• Mixing ink in water is an example of diffusion.
 
• Other examples include how smells spread out through the air and how concentrated liquids spread out when placed in water

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conversion**: Conversion refers to the process of changing something from one form, state, or system to another. 
 
• Devolution refers to the delegation of powers from a central authority to local or regional governments.
 
• Confusion involves a state of disorder or misunderstanding, where clarity is lacking.
